adjudication.rationale:
In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration does `execute(...)[0]['value']` when falling back to `uncategorized_category_id`:

```rb
category_id = execute("SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id'")[0]['value'].to_i
```

If that SELECT returns 0 rows, `execute(...)[0]` will be `nil` and `['value']` will raise `NoMethodError`. The same pattern also exists earlier for the `embed_category` lookup (`...[0]['id']`). So the finding about a possible crash due to indexing into an empty result is grounded in the diff.
